details:
Hand tracking could of been a boon to those with hand injuries but instead due to the poor input methods provided they are a complete and total nightmare.

Please allow alternative options to pinching gestures and movement that requires excessive wrist movement.

These can cause legitimate pain and irritation to users with hand issues or steadily cause said issues to form over time if used for an extended period over long sessions. 

Pinching ones pointer finger to their thumbtip and tilting their wrist forward is a common part of testing for issues like tendonitis, carpal tunnel, and other wrist injuries due to the fact it causes one's ulnar nerve to apply a large amount of pressure on the carpal nerve. 

These same motions also cause unecessary tension on the user's Abductor Pollicis (one of the thumb ligaments), and Transverse Carpal Ligament, which if injured will cause extreme pain throughout ones entire hand.

I do not want to appear to be expressing hyperbole or exaggerating but these controls may be legitimately dangerous for users in the long term if someone is using them over regular controllers. Someone flicking their hand forward too hard in a game world could cause a debilitating ligament injury that could paralyze their entire hand, or remove the functionality of their thumb.

Please reconsider the control layout or consult an ergonomist regarding this issue.
title: Hand Tracking Pinch+tilt Controls Can Irritate/cause Repeat Stress Injuries.
